name: CP-1414S
summary: CP-1414S is an experimental drug first made by a team in Germany. It is a benzodiazepine derivative. CP-1414S is a 1,5-benzodiazepine, with the nitrogen atoms located at positions 1 and 5 of the diazepine ring, and so is most closely related to clobazam.

pharmacology.text: CP-1414S has primarily anxiolytic and anticonvulsant effects.

uses.en: It is an experimental compound studied for its anti-anxiety and anti-seizure effects. It has no approved medical use.
uses.zh: 它是實驗性化合物，曾被研究其抗焦慮與抗癲癇作用，沒有核准的醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是实验性化合物，曾被研究其抗焦虑与抗癫痫作用，没有核准的医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the benzodiazepines, can cause drowsiness, poor coordination and memory problems, lead to dependence with dangerous withdrawal including seizures, and in overdose can slow breathing.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。同類的苯二氮平類藥物可能造成嗜睡、協調變差與記憶問題，可能導致依賴，戒斷時可能出現包括癲癇發作在內的危險症狀，過量時可能抑制呼吸。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。同类的苯二氮平类药物可能造成嗜睡、协调制差与记忆问题，可能导致依赖，戒断时可能出现包括癫痫发作在内的危险症状，过量时可能抑制呼吸。

fact.en: Only a few benzodiazepines have their two ring nitrogens at positions 1 and 5. Clobazam is the best known of them, and CP-1414S is one of its close relatives.
fact.zh: 只有少數苯二氮平類的兩個環上氮原子位於第 1 與第 5 位，其中最有名的是氯巴占，CP-1414S 則是它的近親之一。
fact.zhHans: 只有少数苯二氮平类的两个环上氮原子位于第 1 与第 5 位，其中最有名的是氯巴占，CP-1414S 则是它的近亲之一。
